subject: general
question: Some of the advantages of transpiration to plants are mentioned below. Select the option that is a disadvantage.

options.text: Provides water to leaf for photosynthesis
causes cooling of plants by evaporation

solution:
The correct answer is __**can cause wilting of plants**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Can cause wilting of plants** is a disadvantage of transpiration.
 
• Transpiration is the process of water movement through a plant and its evaporation from aerial parts, especially from the leaves.
 
• While transpiration has several advantages, such as providing water for photosynthesis, transporting mineral ions, and cooling the plant through evaporation, it can also lead to wilting if the water loss exceeds the water uptake.
 
• Wilting occurs when the plant loses more water through transpiration than it can absorb from the soil, leading to a loss of turgor pressure and causing the plant to droop.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Transpiration** plays a crucial role in the water cycle and helps in nutrient uptake from the soil.
 
• It also helps in maintaining the temperature of the plant by cooling it through the evaporation process.
 
• However, excessive transpiration can lead to water stress, especially in arid conditions or during periods of drought.
 
• Plants have evolved various mechanisms to minimize water loss, such as closing their stomata, developing thick cuticles, and having reduced leaf surface area.
